items.title: Make certified tournament advancement fail closed on durable persistence
items.why: reportCertifiedResult mutates the in-memory winner/game/certificate state, persistMatch catches every database error, and bracket advancement still returns success. A restart can erase a publicly certified outcome while the caller received a success response.
items.recipe: Make persistence return a truthful result, snapshot and restore the match on failure, advance only after the certified result is durable, surface a typed persistence error, and test failure rollback plus successful idempotent replay.
executionLog: Made certified result persistence truthful, rollback-safe, and advancement-gating.
Failure rollback and successful idempotent replay regressions passed.

items.title: Cross-bind archived roster identity inside CertifiedGameAuthority
items.why: The shared authority verifies certificate bytes but builds persistent identity from an independently mutable GameRecord roster. Winner projection filters missing identities, so a partially mapped team winner can collapse into a plausible single winner.
items.recipe: Require exact unique client roster equality between GameRecord and certificate stats, reject duplicate persistent identities, make winner projection fail closed when any winning client lacks a mapping, and add archive-tamper plus partial-team tests.
executionLog: Bound archived and certified rosters exactly and rejected duplicate identities.
Archive tamper, partial-team, and duplicate-winner regressions passed.

items.title: Make in-memory and PostgreSQL placement ratings semantically identical
items.why: PostgreSQL passes matchesPlayed to EloRating.calculate while the memory path accepts its Infinity default, disabling the doubled placement K-factor in local development and tests.
items.recipe: Pass the current memory match count through the same rating calculation and add a five-match boundary test proving 64-point placement and 32-point established K-factor semantics.
executionLog: Passed the memory player's match count into Elo calculation.
Five-placement-match and established K-factor boundary regressions passed.

items.title: Make innovation regeneration preserve every source-backed shipped candidate
items.why: Work exhaustion read 37/37 from the checked-in JSON, then innovation-pack.mjs rewrote both artifacts as 36/36 and deleted unified-certified-game-authority because the generator never learned the shipped candidate.
items.recipe: Add the source-derived candidate to the generator and a regression test that runs the generator in an isolated fixture and proves regeneration cannot shrink or forget the shared authority evidence.
executionLog: Added the source-backed shared-authority candidate to canonical generation.
Isolated regeneration regression preserved the complete innovation ledger.

items.title: Teach one exact convoy-to-Breach victory loop everywhere
items.why: GAMEPLAY_DESIGN ends at repeat and First Extraction says shield/intercept even though a normal delivery completes convoyAction. The live game wins by opening Breach after three deliveries and delivering again inside the window.
items.recipe: Create one player-facing victory-loop copy authority, reuse it in First Extraction orientation, align convoyAction wording with its actual completion rule, update gameplay design, and test the canonical copy and completion semantics.
executionLog: Centralized and reused the exact four-delivery Breach victory guidance.
Canonical copy and convoy completion semantics regressions passed.

items.title: Gate deployable dependency risk without making CI lie about dev-only aliases
items.why: All five recent CI runs fail on npm audit --audit-level=moderate although the recorded decision proves production audit zero and defers npm 11 aliases because force-fix breaks semantic-release or the verified Node matrix.
items.recipe: Change the CI release gate to npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=moderate, retain full-tree advisory visibility as non-blocking evidence if useful, and add an executable workflow contract assertion so production scope cannot drift.
executionLog: Scoped the blocking CI vulnerability gate to production dependencies.
Executable workflow contract protects production audit scope from drift.
